definition: Set up Honua in Docker locally or in our supported AWS topologies with an agent. Run ops. Set up services. Then make maps with Studio.

heldOut.source: sealed pack decrypted only inside ai-arc.yml

candidate.binding: phases.candidate {sourceRevision, imageDigest, platformLockDigest} from the candidate platform lock, as gate-upgrade binds it

customerScript.say: Yes, use the three layers you just loaded.
Shelters on top, parcels at the bottom.
Name it Flood planning and share it with the operators only.

handoffs.setup: Honua was installed earlier today. The earlier note from the person who installed it says: {previous}
handoffs.ops: Honua was updated earlier. The earlier note says: {previous}
handoffs.services: Our data was loaded earlier. The earlier note says: {previous}

local-docker.host: ephemeral VM Docker host reached over a runner-owned SSH connection
local-docker.setupSurface: allow-listed recorded shell in a scratch directory on the host

setup.A: Please install Honua on this computer with Docker, using the release in the setup notes and the getting-started guide in this folder. Tell me when it is running and how I sign in.
setup.B: I want to try Honua on my own machine. Can you get it running in Docker for me? The setup notes say which release to use, and the guide is in this folder. Let me know when I can sign in.

ops.A: Honua is running from the earlier setup. Please update it to the newer release in the notes, make sure everything still works, and roll back if it doesn't. Afterwards, find out why the service that's now failing is unhealthy and tell me what you changed.
ops.B: We need to move our Honua to the newer release in the notes without losing anything. If the update goes wrong, put it back how it was. Something also seems broken since this morning; can you look into it and get it working again?

services.A: Now that Honua is up to date, import the Kestrel parcels, flood zones and shelters, and make them available as read-only services. Share them with our operators only, and create a temporary read-only key for our app, check it, then turn it off.
services.B: Can you load the Willow parcel, flooding and shelter files into Honua and give our apps a way to read them without changing anything? Only our operator team should see them. Our app also needs short-lived read access; please test it and switch it off afterwards without showing me the secret.

maps.A: Make a Kestrel map in Studio with parcels underneath the flood zones and shelters on top. Make the flood zones blue and see-through, label shelters with their names, save it, and share it with our operators.
maps.B: Can you use Studio to put Willow's parcels, flood areas and shelters on one map? The flooding should be transparent blue and the shelters should have their names beside them. Please keep the map and let the operator team open it.

setup.A: Set up Honua for Kestrel in our AWS account, using the release in the setup notes. We want it on managed containers, the standard way. Ask me before you create anything that costs money, and use only the access you actually need. Tell me when I can sign in.
setup.B: Can you get Honua running in our AWS account for Willow? The notes have the release and our requirements; we'd like it on managed containers, the standard way. Please check with me before you build anything, and don't ask for more access than the job needs.
